Privacy policy

How Roam uses information when you sign in, join groups and play games.

Who runs Roam

[Legal operator name] operates Roam. For privacy questions and requests, contact [Support email].

Information Roam uses

  • Account: Apple or Google sign-in information, an account identifier, and your display name.
  • Groups and games: Group and game details you enter, memberships, invites, game activity, gift assignments and rewards.
  • Notifications: Alert preferences and, if enabled, a device token used to deliver alerts.

Why we use it

We use this information to sign you in, run groups and games, manage invitations, track rewards, deliver updates, and keep accounts and games secure.

Who can see it

Other players can see your display name where you play together. Invite previews may show group or game details. Your assigned Secret Santa recipient is shown privately to you. We use service providers including Supabase for account and app data and Expo and platform notification services for push delivery. Apple and Google handle their own sign-in services.

Retention and choices

Roam keeps account and game information as needed to provide the service. You can change your display name and alert settings in Profile. Account deletion removes your account and profile. A matched gift exchange can keep a reference without your name or email so existing assignments stay intact.

See how to delete your account or contact us for a privacy request.
